runner.name: Claude Code

old_runner_failure.max_effort: Effort level "max" is not available for Claude.ai subscribers
old_runner_failure.model: API 400 claude_code_version_too_old: version 2.1.280 or newer is required

runner.effort_probe: max and xhigh accepted locally on 2.1.299 (no warning; an invalid value produces a warning). The provider does not echo effort, so applied effort is unknown. Under a clean env, max produced a thinking block on a trivial prompt where the inherited env (CLAUDE_EFFORT=high) produced none
runner.fallback: none (no --fallback-model; user settings incl. switchModelsOnFlag not loaded via --setting-sources project)
runner.memory: autoMemoryEnabled=false + CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1; no ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, skills or agents exist; enabledPlugins empty
runner.auth: existing local Claude subscription login (keychain); apiKeySource=none

0xsimao.modifications: none; packaged as plugin wrapper RT/harness/plugins/simao (files byte-identical)

trailofbits.note: six-skill aggregate, not the full catalog; spec-compliance workflow natively sets some agents to effort low/medium

lane_harness.profile: solc 0.8.36, cancun, optimizer 200, via_ir false (mirrors profile.default); production sources byte-identical copies
